baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from ظَنَّ and نَاجٍ through ٱذْكُرْنِى عِندَ رَبِّكَ to أَنسَىٰهُ and فَلَبِثَ ties a predicted release, a speech commission, its failure, and continued confinement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Joseph identifies a viable survivor, commissions him to carry Joseph's name into a master's presence, and depends on remembered speech to cross the prison-court boundary. Induced forgetting severs that access chain, so a failed message becomes prolonged confinement.

activation_trace.role: Sign-based conviction marks the chosen inmate as a viable future carrier.
Escape by separation supplies the carrier's route out of confinement.
Remembrance voiced aloud makes the commission a transmissible speech act.
Nearness and presence define the master's audience as the message's destination.
Mastery and ownership identify the authority whose hearing can alter Joseph's position.
Loss of held remembrance is the immediate break in transmission.
Distance and severance give the disrupting agency a relational effect.
Continued dwelling converts the failed transmission into duration.
Confinement supplies the fixed spatial consequence of the broken chain.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a request followed by an accidental delay.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an access chain: a marked survivor must carry Joseph's spoken name into a master's presence, and induced forgetting turns a communication failure into years of confinement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired forms ٱذْكُرْنِى/ذِكْرَ and رَبِّكَ/رَبِّهِ, together with the pronouns in أَنسَىٰهُ, leave more than one locally anchored assignment live.
baseline_models.mechanism: One reading makes the survivor forget the oral mention of Joseph before his human master. A coexisting reflexive reading hears Joseph's appeal through a human master as coinciding with a lapse from remembrance of his divine Lord. The verse's repeated roots sustain the tension without forcing one merged referent.

activation_trace.role: Mental re-presentation after absence supports remembrance as an inward state.
Voiced mention supports the rival outward commission to speak of Joseph.
The shared title can denote both a human master and divine sovereignty.
Corrective care and gradual completion keep a pedagogical reading available.
Forgetting as neglect permits either an abandoned commission or neglected divine remembrance.

changed_reading.before: Both occurrences of remembrance and lord have one obvious referent.
changed_reading.after: Two assignments coexist: the survivor neglects Joseph's mention before his master, while a secondary reflexive hearing makes the human appeal resonate with neglected remembrance of the divine Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing cluster فَلَبِثَ فِى ٱلسِّجْنِ بِضْعَ سِنِينَ binds staying, confinement, a sub-decade quantity, and years into one temporal object.
baseline_models.mechanism: The delay is not featureless vagueness. The numerical term presents it as a cut-off portion below a full decimal boundary, while staying and durable confinement make that bounded portion adhere to one place.

activation_trace.role: Slowness and suspension make the interval an arrested process.
Durable severity makes confinement temporally adhesive rather than merely locative.
A number cut off below the next decade gives the delay a bounded but unresolved measure.
The material sense of a severed piece sharpens the years into a detached block of life.
The explicit year branch supplies the unit in which the bounded block is endured.

changed_reading.before: Several years is an imprecise note about how long Joseph waited.
changed_reading.after: The ending carves out a bounded yet deliberately uncounted block of life and fixes that whole block inside confinement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Joseph asks to be mentioned at authority, not explicitly to be released, and the focus inventory lets ذِكْر carry reputation and attested right as well as recollection.
baseline_models.mechanism: The request can seek circulation of Joseph's name and claim within an authoritative audience. On this reading, memory is a social medium: being spoken of restores standing, while being forgotten suppresses both reputation and access.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people supplies the social medium for Joseph's case.
Reputation and public standing make mention consequential beyond bare recall.
An attested claim or right makes the requested mention resemble presentation of a case.
Presence before authority supplies the forum in which reputation can be restored.
Mastery gives the intended audience power to act on the restored claim.

changed_reading.before: Mention me to your master is simply an indirect request to get me out.
changed_reading.after: The request first seeks entry of Joseph's name, standing, and possible claim into authoritative circulation; release is one possible consequence rather than the wording's whole content.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior prediction specifies that the survivor will resume serving drink to his master. That service gives him recurring bodily proximity to the exact audience named in Joseph's commission, so Joseph's choice is role-targeted rather than merely opportunistic.

activation_trace.role: Oral mention is the payload that needs an access-bearing carrier.
Presence at the master is the required delivery condition.
Serving a drink supplies the survivor's recurring court-facing function.
The served master is the same class of authority addressed by the commission.

structural_cues: 12:41 differentiates the two prisoners by fate and places the survivor in direct service to a master immediately before 12:42.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restored drink-service and a request for mention in the master's presence; I infer that service creates reliable conversational access. A live alternative is that Joseph chooses him simply because he is the only survivor.

changed_reading.before: Joseph asks whichever prisoner survives to carry a message.
changed_reading.after: Joseph commissions the survivor whose predicted office will repeatedly place him beside the needed authority, making the forgotten message a failure of a specifically chosen access channel.

context_deltas.mechanism: A royal dream reproduces the earlier prison problem, the court fails to interpret it, and only then does the survivor remember after an interval and initiate a sending. Forgetting therefore behaves less like deletion than a dormant trace reactivated by a structurally matching need.

activation_trace.role: A remembrance that has left active awareness supplies the latent state.
A new dream supplies a problem structurally similar to the survivor's prison experience.
The court's diagnosis of mixed dreams creates a failed-search condition that can cue the old interpreter.
Recovered mental presence makes the packet's later event an explicit reversal of forgetting.
The after-before relation marks a real interval between encoding and retrieval.
Sending converts reactivated memory back into motion across the prison-court boundary.

structural_cues: 12:43-45 sequences royal dream, court interpretive failure, survivor recollection, and dispatch.
12:45 repeats both the survivor identity and the remembrance root from the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated dream problem immediately before explicit recollection; I supply the associative arrow from matched problem to retrieval. The alternative is spontaneous recall after elapsed time, with the dream only providing an occasion to speak.

changed_reading.before: Satanic forgetting erases Joseph's request until an arbitrary later moment.
changed_reading.after: The request persists as latent memory and becomes actionable when a matching interpretive crisis exposes the court's need for what the survivor once encountered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding discourse distinguishes dispersed lords from the one overpowering God and assigns ultimate judgment to God; later, one sentence juxtaposes 'your lord' and 'my Lord.' These cues make the focus's repeated title operate on two levels: a human master is a real access point inside, not a replacement for, divine sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The title's range across owner, master, and divine Lord permits nested authorities.
Plural masters make the human or subordinate use of the title explicit.
Differentiation prevents the several authorities from collapsing into one referent.
Divine uniqueness establishes the superior level of sovereignty.
Judgment between people supplies the governing power reserved ultimately for God.
The later paired uses openly distinguish the messenger's master from the speaker's Lord.

structural_cues: 12:39-40 places the human-language plurality of lords beside divine unity and exclusive judgment.
12:50 uses the same root twice in a construction that marks two possessive perspectives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit authority contrasts before and after the focus; I read them backward as sharpening its two uses of lord into nested levels. The alternative is that both focus possessives refer only to the survivor and his human master despite the larger theological frame.

changed_reading.before: Appealing to a human master competes directly with reliance on the divine Lord.
changed_reading.after: The human master is a subordinate institutional address inside a discourse of exclusive divine sovereignty, so practical mediation and ultimate lordship can remain distinct without being merged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The survivor's explicit later recollection and the later contrast between 'your lord' and 'my Lord' favor the interpersonal referral reading. Yet the subsequent first-person refusal of self-exoneration keeps a reflexive ethical hearing alive: human recourse may still be heard against divine corrective care, but no longer as the only grammatical explanation of the delay.

activation_trace.role: Neglect supplies the possible ethical lapse in the reflexive reading.
Corrective care lets continued waiting be heard pedagogically rather than only punitively.
The survivor's recovered remembrance strongly supplies the interpersonal subject of the earlier lapse.
Explicitly contrasted possessors weaken a forced single-level assignment in the focus.
Refusal to place the self wholly at a distance from fault preserves ethical self-scrutiny.
The inward faculty of thought and impulse supplies a live reflexive domain.
Merciful care keeps correction compatible with preservation rather than condemnation.

structural_cues: 12:45 names the survivor as the one who later remembers.
12:50 sharply distinguishes a human addressee's lord from the speaker's Lord.
12:53 introduces first-person self-examination and divine mercy without resolving the earlier pronouns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies later recall, referent contrast, and self-examination; I use the later scenes to reweight rather than erase the earlier ambiguity. A live alternative is that 12:53 has no backward bearing on 12:42 and the reflexive reading should be dropped entirely.

changed_reading.before: Satan makes Joseph forget God, and imprisonment follows as a direct correction for seeking human help.
changed_reading.after: The later sequence makes the survivor-chain reading primary, but a secondary ethical resonance remains: the appeal through human power can still invite self-scrutiny under divine care without becoming a settled causal verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped branch of the repeated lord-root supplies feeding and growth; the following program turns years into cycles of cultivation, sustained labor, hardship, and eventual capacity. This activates a developmental reading in which prison time is an interval of maturation before Joseph can be established in responsibility.

activation_trace.role: The split target's nourishment and growth image supplies the developmental frame.
Suspension supplies the interval in which maturation can occur.
Years provide the repeated units shared by confinement and the later plan.
Planting and growth make patient development operational in the later crisis.
Persistent exertion gives the years disciplined content rather than empty passage.
Hard strength supplies the pressure under which stored capacity becomes necessary.
Empowerment supplies the matured institutional outcome of the interval.

structural_cues: 12:47-49 converts a sequence of years into cultivation, preservation, severity, and relief.
12:54-56 follows the delayed release with tested speech, trust, office, and establishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the split growth branch and the later agricultural-to-office sequence; I metaphorically align Joseph's prison years with cultivation. It does not explicitly state that imprisonment caused his maturation, and mere temporal preparation remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The extra years are only the penalty or consequence of a failed message.
changed_reading.after: The years can also be carried as a cultivation interval: sustained delay precedes the precise knowledge, endurance, and institutional capacity the coming crisis will require.

context_deltas.mechanism: When release becomes available, Joseph sends the messenger back for an inquiry; truth is exposed, non-betrayal is articulated, and only then does exclusive royal selection and empowerment follow. The original request to be mentioned before authority thus matures from private intercession into public restoration of standing.

activation_trace.role: Public reputation supplies the social object that must be restored.
An attested right supplies the juridical edge of the requested mention.
Authoritative presence remains the forum in which the case can change status.
Returning the messenger reverses the expected immediate exit and reopens the old case.
Formal asking turns mention into investigation rather than favor alone.
Truth emerging into visibility supplies the public reversal of suppressed reputation.
Establishing and displaying right converts recollection into vindication.
Faithfulness under absence defines the reputation the inquiry restores.
Exclusive selection converts cleared standing into close royal service.
Empowerment shows that restored mention yields agency, not release alone.

structural_cues: 12:50 interrupts an immediate royal summons with a return-message and inquiry.
12:51-52 establishes truth and fidelity before 12:54 grants proximity, trust, and power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the inquiry-vindication-selection sequence; I infer that the earlier request already had reputational potential because it asks for mention, not release. A live alternative is that Joseph sought release in 12:42 and only later raised the standard to public exoneration.

changed_reading.before: The forgotten request is a private plea for freedom.
changed_reading.after: The request opens a delayed path to authoritative hearing: Joseph ultimately refuses bare extraction from prison until his name is publicly cleared, allowing mention to become vindication and trusted agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph first suffers because another person fails to retain and transmit a remembrance. The later plan requires years of disciplined storage, and Joseph identifies himself as a vigilant guardian. Personal memory failure is thus reversed at a social scale into an office devoted to preserving what a population will later need.

activation_trace.role: Lost remembrance supplies the initial failure of retention.
Held and recovered presence supplies the cognitive side of preservation.
Persistent practice supplies the discipline required for multi-year retention.
Secure storage translates preservation from memory into material administration.
Guarding and careful maintenance define Joseph's eventual public function.
Wakeful resistance to inattention directly reverses the focus ayah's lapse.

structural_cues: 12:55 joins storehouses with Joseph's claim to be a knowing guardian.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical-functional opposition between forgetting and guarding plus a storage program; I read that as thematic reversal across personal and civic scales. The alternative is that the later language is only a practical qualification with no backward relation to 12:42.

changed_reading.before: Joseph is passively trapped by another person's failure to remember.
changed_reading.after: The memory failure becomes the negative image of Joseph's later vocation: he moves from being harmed by failed retention to guarding a society through disciplined remembrance and storage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material rope branch of ش ط ن rather than the ordinary personal designation. It remains anchored in the explicit شَّيْطَٰنُ token and the immediate sequence from disruption to prolonged staying in prison. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for extended causal attachment, never as a replacement etymology or literal rope in the scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The disrupting subject is immediately followed by continued dwelling in confinement for years, allowing a long-tether image to model how a momentary lapse acquires duration.

activation_trace.role: A long, tightly worked cord supplies the material image of disruption stretched into attachment.
Continued staying turns the cord image into temporal tethering.
The prison fixes the place to which the figurative tether holds Joseph.
Years extend the effect far beyond the initiating cognitive lapse.

changed_reading.before: Satan causes a momentary act of forgetting.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the disruption behaves like a long tether: one lapse remains causally attached to Joseph and holds him in place across years.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and is later activated by an actual ق ل ل occurrence. It remains anchored in the initiating قَالَ, the severed time-portion, and the later rationing of a little. Downstream prose must qualify it as a scale contrast, not translate قَالَ as small or claim a lexical identity between the roots.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A single speech commission at the ayah's opening is followed by a cut-off block of years, creating a disproportion between a minimal intervention and its temporal consequence.

activation_trace.role: The split target contributes smallness as an exploratory scale for the initiating utterance.
A severed piece turns the resulting years into a disproportionate block.
The later instruction to consume only a little activates smallness as deliberate rationing.
Repeated small remainder reinforces an economy in which tiny allocations have long effects.

changed_reading.before: Joseph's brief request is merely the narrative cause of a later delay.
changed_reading.after: As a contained scale analogy, one low-volume intervention fails to circulate and opens a vastly larger temporal block, anticipating the later logic of rationed smallness across years.

strongest_changes: The survivor is a role-targeted access channel whose restored drink-service places him beside the intended master.
Forgetting is revised from erasure into dormant memory reactivated by a matching dream crisis and court failure.
Human and divine lordship become nested but distinct, preserving both practical mediation and theological sovereignty.
The request for mention matures into public vindication, trusted proximity, and agency rather than bare release.
The memory failure is later reversed into Joseph's civic role as a vigilant guardian of stored provision.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained competing pronoun readings while activating two unusually productive reversals: forgotten remembrance becomes latent recall and then guardianship, while prison years become both a bounded loss and an exploratory cultivation interval. Split mapped roots also yielded contained, non-final readings without displacing the dominant morphology.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedents and semantic level of أَنسَىٰهُ and رَبِّهِ remain locally contestable even after later context reweights them.
The packet supports temporal preparation but does not state that imprisonment causally produced Joseph's maturity or office.
The reputational and juridical force of mention is activated by the later inquiry but may exceed the original request's immediate intent.
The long-tether and small-utterance models depend on branch-distant material analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.
